mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(account.current_balance) FROM connected_account account INNER JOIN codef_connection connection ON connection.connection_id = account.connection_id WHERE connection.user_id = #{userId} AND connection.status = 'ACTIVE' AND account.status = 'ACTIVE' ), 0) AS base_asset, goal.target_amount, profile.soldier_type, profile.enlistment_date, profile.discharge_date FROM soldier_profile profile INNER JOIN goal ON goal.user_id = profile.user_id AND goal.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE profile.user_id = #{userId}
